title: Code and results for "Cross-dataset transfer of conformal abstention thresholds in chest radiograph classification"
description:
Python code, result files and console logs for the article "Cross-dataset transfer of conformal abstention thresholds in chest radiograph classification". The code builds a frozen BiomedCLIP encoder with linear, Platt-calibrated concept heads and evaluates two conformal abstention rules, a split-conformal false-deferral threshold and a conformal risk control selective threshold, on-site and after transfer between NIH ChestX-ray14, VinDr-CXR and the Indiana University chest X-ray collection. Sensitivity analyses cover a second encoder (CLIP), a one-hidden-layer concept head, and the full Indiana label set.

The archive includes the result files and console logs of the reported runs, from which every number in the article is taken, and a step-by-step reproduction guide that maps each table and figure to its script and result file.

The data are not redistributed. NIH ChestX-ray14 is available from the NIH Clinical Center, VinDr-CXR from PhysioNet under credentialed access (the study used the 512-pixel copy redistributed on Kaggle), and the Indiana collection from the National Library of Medicine (Open-i). The archive contains no images.
